entities.summary: Darrell Antwonne Arthur is an American former professional basketball player. He played college basketball for the Kansas Jayhawks for two seasons, and was part of their 2007–08 national championship team. He was drafted by the New Orleans Hornets in the 2008 NBA draft but after two trades, he ended up with the Memphis Grizzlies, with whom he signed on July 8, 2008. He is listed at 6 feet 9 inches (2.06 m), 235 lb (107 kg) and played the power forward position.
